recheck.prior_verdict: NEEDS_REVISION (BLOCKER DEFECT-2 workgroup-hole OOB crash + 2 cosmetic findings)
recheck.summary: The BLOCKER is RESOLVED and independently re-verified on real hardware. The per-variant `local_size_from_spirv`-derived dispatch geometry turns the canonical `@strategy { workgroup_x: ?[32,64] }` autotune pattern from a 3/3 Lavapipe SIGSEGV into a working feature: I ran the reviewer's OWN canonical fixture through the shipped `axc optimize` CLI 2x on Lavapipe (task item 1) — both exit 0, real winner (fallback_used=false), artifacts written, ZERO crashes — plus 5 more Lavapipe runs and the NVIDIA CLI, all clean. Geometry is per-variant-CORRECT, not merely crash-free: winner workgroup_x=64 emits LocalSize(64,1,1) and workgroup_x=32 emits LocalSize(32,1,1), byte-parsed from the winning .spv, matching the sidecar assignment each run. Both cosmetic findings addressed; spec §5 and the run-JSON framing corrected in place; cargo test --workspace clean (102 test-result groups, 0 failed); all GPU-gated ATs green on BOTH platforms. Flipping to APPROVE.

scoped_items.1_canonical_fixture_repro_2x: PASS — reviewer's exact canonical fixture (`@kernel @workgroup(?workgroup_x,1,1) @strategy { workgroup_x: ?[32,64] } fn k(out: buffer[f32]) { out[gid(0)]=1.0 }`) via the SHIPPED `axc optimize` binary on Lavapipe (VK_DRIVER_FILES=lvp_icd.json, llvmpipe LLVM 20.1.2 / Mesa 25.2.8), --correctness none: RUN1 exit 0, RUN2 exit 0 (then 5 more, all exit 0). Real winner each run (run1 workgroup_x=64, run2 workgroup_x=32, fallback_used=false, genuinely-differing GpuTimestamp medians). Winner .spv OpExecutionMode LocalSize byte-parsed: run1=(64,1,1), run2=(32,1,1) — matches the winning assignment exactly. Previously 3/3 SIGSEGV/heap-corruption, zero artifacts; now every run writes .spv + sidecar.
scoped_items.2_local_size_from_spirv_and_fallback: PASS — opcode scan verified against the SPIR-V spec: OP_EXECUTION_MODE=16 (correct), MODE_LOCAL_SIZE=17 (correct), word layout right (words[i+1]=entry id, words[i+2]=mode, words[i+3..i+5]=x/y/z literals), 5-word module-header skip correct, word_count>=6 guard correct, malformed/truncated stream returns None (fail-closed to metadata). One entry point per module here — first-LocalSize return is safe. Fallback: a literal `@workgroup(64,1,1)` fixture (SCALE value hole) run through the CLI on Lavapipe exits 0 with LocalSize(64,1,1) preserved — geometry identical to pre-fix. (Note: for a literal kernel `local_size_from_spirv` itself SUCCEEDS returning (64,1,1)==metadata, so the `unwrap_or(workgroup_size)` fallback is belt-and-suspenders; literal-kernel behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged either way.)
scoped_items.3_at3017_divergence_mechanism_replacemen: PASS — the new `local_invocation_id(0)`-based `diverge_src` (out[i]=x[i]+lid) is intrinsically workgroup-dependent at the SAME global id (lid=i%32 vs i%64), not reliant on any over/under-dispatch. AT-3017 (candidates 32,64) and AT-3017b (64,32) both return VariantsDiverge with ZERO artifacts on BOTH Lavapipe and NVIDIA. Verified the old `i % 1024` over-dispatch-aliasing mechanism no longer diverges post-fix (confirmed via CLI that geometry is now exact 1024 threads). The replacement diverges for the RIGHT reason (in-bounds, non-UB, workgroup-size-dependent).
scoped_items.4_at3018_both_platforms: PASS — at_3018_canonical_workgroup_hole_geometry_fix_repro passes on Lavapipe AND NVIDIA (isolated --test-threads=1). Asserts Ok result, .spv + sidecar written, winner is a real candidate (32/64), and winner .spv LocalSize matches the winning workgroup_x — per-variant correctness, not just crash-avoidance.
scoped_items.5_ordinal_mapping_true_ordinals: PASS (by rigorous inspection + partial empirical). The remap `cfn_call_to_true_ordinal = result.results.filter(!Failed starts_with 'resolve error:'|'codegen error:').map(ordinal)` EXACTLY reconstructs the set of variants for which grid_search invokes cfn: cross-checked against grid_search.rs — cfn is skipped only via the two `continue`s at resolve-failure (line 195, Failed 'resolve error:') and codegen-failure (line 210, Failed 'codegen error:'); every other variant (including CorrectnessRejected and bench-Failed-without-those-prefixes) has cfn called and is RETAINED; results are pushed in ascending ordinal order, so the Nth cfn call maps to the Nth surviving entry's true variant.ordinal. Empirically confirmed the divergence path records the exact call-index reference-duplication pattern `[0,1,0,2]` the code writes (ord3 fixture, 3 variants all cfn'd → call-index==ordinal identity). NOTE: I could NOT isolate a clean NON-crashing resolve/codegen-skip-with-downstream-divergence via the CLI on available hardware: the only grid_search-level compile-failure trigger is a shared-element over-cap, and any SURVIVING shared variant then either SIGSEGVs this Lavapipe (pre-existing DEFECT-1, re-reproduced 2x) or perturbs the NVIDIA divergence; the @workgroup>1024-invocation ceiling is enforced only at the F4 re-compile (AT-3015), not inside grid_search's resolve (a workgroup_x=2000 candidate dispatched rather than skipping). The remap is a pure post-processing transform on a ZERO-artifact error path and is correct by construction; the residual is a test-harness limitation, not a code doubt.
scoped_items.6_spec5_and_runjson_framing: PASS — .pipeline/milestones/M3.23-real-bench.md §5 'Hole that parameterises @workgroup dims' corrected IN PLACE: the wrong 'under-coverage caught by the oracle, else NotChecked' prediction is replaced with the real failure mode (over-dispatch OOB → crash on non-robustBufferAccess / silent-wrong-output on NVIDIA, undetectable by an oracle since the crash precedes readback) plus the fix. The run-JSON framing = M3.23-coder.json self_assessment.known_limitations[1], corrected in place (SUPERSEDED marker, original text preserved verbatim): reframes the TRIGGERING code (run_optimize's invariant-metadata capture at optimize.rs ~231-235 + its derive_workgroups use) as 100% NEW to M3.23, with only the enabling conditions (HIR placeholder dims, resolve_single_variant legacy-convention resolution) pre-existing. Factually correct.
scoped_items.7_cargo_test_workspace: PASS — `cargo test --workspace` clean: 102 'test result: ok' groups, ZERO 'test result:' lines with non-zero failures. GPU-gated ATs (AT-3007/3008/3017/3017b/3018) pass on Lavapipe (5/5) and the divergence/AT-3018 set on NVIDIA.

the_ruling_defect_2.ruling: BLOCKER -> NEEDS_REVISION. Ship-with-backlog is NOT acceptable. The crash is in the feature being shipped, it hits the single most canonical use of `axc optimize` (tuning workgroup size), and the correct fix is genuinely SMALL. Per the mandate's own test ('if small -> NEEDS_REVISION with the fix'), the milestone must land the per-variant-geometry fix before merge.
the_ruling_defect_2.repro: Wrote the canonical autotune fixture `@kernel @workgroup(?workgroup_x,1,1) @strategy { workgroup_x: ?[32,64] } fn k(out: buffer[f32]) { out[gid(0)] = 1.0; }` and ran the SHIPPED branch binary `axc optimize wgx_hole.axc -o out.spv --correctness none` under Lavapipe (VK_DRIVER_FILES=lvp_icd.json, llvmpipe LLVM 20.1.2). Result: SIGSEGV / glibc 'corrupted size vs. prev_size' heap-corruption abort, exit 139/127, 3/3 runs, ZERO artifacts written. A control fixture with a LITERAL `@workgroup(64,1,1)` (no geometry hole) runs cleanly to exit 0 on the SAME Lavapipe -> the crash is the OOB dispatch, NOT an environmental Lavapipe defect.
the_ruling_defect_2.root_cause_confirmed: run_optimize's NEW invariant-metadata capture (optimize.rs ~line 187: `workgroup_size = [selected.annotations.workgroup.{x,y,z}]`) reads the HIR PLACEHOLDER dim (=1) when `@workgroup` is itself a `?hole`. `derive_workgroups([4096-byte buffers -> 1024 elems], [1,1,1], None)` therefore returns 1024 workgroups. But the library's `resolve_single_variant` resolves the legacy convention name `workgroup_x` to the real value, so the compiled variant SPIR-V carries LocalSize=32 (I confirmed this by parsing OpExecutionMode/LocalSize out of the emitted words: `LocalSize = 32 1 1`). Net: 1024 workgroups x 32 threads = 32768 threads writing a 1024-element buffer = 32x over-dispatch -> OOB. Lavapipe (no robustBufferAccess) crashes; NVIDIA silently clamps and writes wrong output. This triggering code is 100% new to M3.23 (the old mock never dispatched), as QA's defect-2 correction states.
the_ruling_defect_2.why_ship_with_backlog_floor_is_NOT_met: The current code gives a SILENT crash. Spec section 5 ('Hole that parameterises @workgroup dims') documents this limitation but predicts the WRONG failure mode ('under-coverage is caught by the oracle, else NotChecked') -- the actual failure is OVER-coverage OOB, a process/driver crash. There is no preflight guard and no typed refusal, so not even the documented-limitation+fail-closed floor is satisfied.
the_ruling_defect_2.the_fix_is_small_~20_25_LOC_single_file: Derive geometry PER-VARIANT from the RESOLVED dims that are already present in the compiled `words` each closure receives. Add a small helper `fn local_size_from_spirv(words: &[u32]) -> Option<[u32;3]>` (scan OpExecutionMode opcode 16 / mode 17 LocalSize, ~15 LOC), then inside BOTH the correctness_fn and bench_fn compute `let wg = local_size_from_spirv(words).unwrap_or(workgroup_size); let workgroups = bench_variant::derive_workgroups(&input_sizes, wg, None);` instead of using the pre-captured `workgroups`. This is correct for BOTH cases: legacy-convention holes (LocalSize resolved to 32 -> ceil(1024/32)*32 = 1024 = exact) AND custom-named holes (LocalSize stays 1 -> 1024*1 = exact, preserving AT-3014/AT-3016). No library change (the words already carry the resolved LocalSize), no cross-crate touch (axc-optimize/axc-runtime stay zero-diff), single file (optimize.rs). I verified the emitted LocalSize is the resolved value, so this fix is viable and small.
the_ruling_defect_2.acceptable_alternative_floor_only_if_dee: If the orchestrator disagrees on size, the MINIMUM acceptable substitute is a preflight typed refusal: detect that a `@workgroup` dim of the bench-target is a `HoleRef` whose resolved LocalSize would differ from the placeholder (i.e. a legacy workgroup_x/y/z convention hole), and return a typed `OptimizeError` naming the limitation with ZERO artifacts. But since the per-variant fix is small AND strictly better (it makes workgroup-size autotuning actually WORK rather than refusing it), the fix is required over the guard.

critical_bugs.description: workgroup-dim `@strategy` hole (legacy convention name) causes 32x-64x dispatch over-provisioning -> OOB writes -> Lavapipe SIGSEGV/heap-corruption crash (NVIDIA: silent OOB clamped-writes / wrong output). Reproduced 3/3 on the shipped binary via the canonical `@strategy { workgroup_x: ?[...] }` pattern. Fix = derive geometry per-variant from the compiled words' LocalSize (~20-25 LOC, optimize.rs only).
critical_bugs.line: ~187 (workgroup_size invariant capture) + ~208/~276 (derive_workgroups reused in both closures)

warnings.description: Shared-memory kernels routed through the resident-dispatch harness crash on older Lavapipe. I independently reproduced: the AT-3007/AT-3014-class fixture `shared[i32,?WG]` run through `axc optimize` SIGSEGVs on this sandbox's Lavapipe (llvmpipe LLVM 20.1.2) with 'corrupted size vs. prev_size' heap corruption, exit 139. QA reports the GPU-gated ATs pass on Mesa 25.2.8 -- so the crash is Lavapipe-version-dependent. This is a genuinely pre-existing axc-runtime gap (QA-attributed fairly), NOT introduced by this diff, BUT M3.23 is the first milestone to route shared memory through this harness inside CI-`#[ignore]`-gated tests: if CI's Lavapipe is an older Mesa, AT-3007/AT-3014 will CRASH the CI job (a core dump, not a test failure). Recommend the milestone record note this and/or pin the CI Lavapipe Mesa version. Out of scope for the diff itself; flagged for CI robustness.

The ordinals reported in `OptimizeError::VariantsDiverge { ordinals }` are the correctness_fn CALL-sequence counter (`ordinal` Cell incremented at cfn entry), NOT the library `variant.ordinal`. grid_search skips cfn for any variant that fails resolve/codegen (the `continue` happens BEFORE the correctness check, grid_search.rs:186-227), so the reported ordinals diverge from the sidecar `results[].ordinal` when an earlier variant fails to compile. Also `reference_ord` is pushed on every mismatch, so the vec can contain duplicate reference ordinals (e.g. [0,1,0,2]). Purely cosmetic: this is an error path that writes ZERO artifacts (no sidecar to cross-reference against), and the divergence fixtures all compile so the numbering coincides there. Consider deduping / documenting the numbering if the ordinals are ever surfaced to users.

checks.decision_table_total_over_all_branches: PASS -- three error branches all return BEFORE any fs::write. GpuUnavailable returns before grid_search (optimize.rs ~175). VariantsDiverge returns after grid_search but before F4 and both writes (optimize.rs 296-300). F4 WinnerInvalidModuleWide returns at line 325, before the .spv write (334) and sidecar write (339). saw_not_checked only pushes a warning (proceeds). NotChecked-with-agreement proceeds; divergence-with-attribution proceeds with survivors; divergence-without-attribution fails closed.
checks.zero_artifact_discipline_both_error_path: PASS -- grid_search is a pure library returning a struct (no file I/O; verified crates/axc-optimize/src/grid_search.rs writes nothing). Every early-return between bench completion and the writes (VariantsDiverge, F4) precedes std::fs::write. Independently confirmed on the running binary: GpuUnavailable and the defect-2 crash and QA's VariantsDiverge repro all leave zero .spv / zero sidecar.
checks.differential_one_readback_per_variant: PASS -- correctness_fn does exactly ONE dispatch+readback per variant (before bench_fn's warmup+measured loop), so the differential compares a single deterministic readback per variant. Intra-variant sample-to-sample nondeterminism (a racy kernel) is NOT detected -- but the spec explicitly scopes the M3.16 determinism-check out and the code does not overclaim (the warning text says 'variants AGREED with each other', not 'kernel is deterministic'). No false 'match': the bitwise fast-path runs first, so distinct garbage NaN-pattern buffers (bytes differ) fall through to the ULP leg and are correctly flagged divergent.
checks.oracle_attribution_survivors_only: PASS -- crowning is survivors-only: a variant whose registered oracle returns Failed is CorrectnessRejected inside grid_search (returns Err from cfn -> BenchOutcome::CorrectnessRejected, not benched, excluded from winner selection). oracle_attributed gates the VariantsDiverge decision. The all-variants-rejected path yields grid_search's R3 fallback / NoSuccessfulVariants, never a silent crown of a rejected variant. VariantsDiverge is a typed error, not a crown.
checks.part_b_five_parser_sites: PASS -- all 5 sites (parser.rs 584/853/866/947/960) replaced with int_literal_checked; grep confirms ZERO remaining unwrap_or(i64::MAX|MIN)/i64::try_from/wrapping_neg clamp patterns in parser.rs. Negated i64::MIN (magnitude 2^63) accepted exactly; 2^63+1 rejected; positive i64::MAX+1 rejected; i64::MAX/MIN and ordinary values parse exactly (AT-3010 asserts all four legs). General body-literal path untouched (QA independently confirmed scalar_demo.axc u64::MAX body literal still compiles).
checks.pw1_no_false_negative: PASS -- collect_shared_len_hole_refs seeds ONLY shared[T,?name] length-hole names into referenced_holes (recursing if/else-if/for/while bodies). A genuinely-unused hole (Z) still warns; a hole used only in a shared length (WG) no longer warns (AT-3009 asserts both). No over-marking.
checks.perf_sanity_4_candidate: PASS -- ran a 4-candidate fixture on the shipped binary under Lavapipe: 42ms wall, all 4 variants benched Ok with n_samples=10, real varying MIN timings (38096/40560/41025/41623 ns), NotChecked warning correctly present under --correctness bit-exact (unoracled, differential agreement). Per variant: 1 prepare in correctness_fn + 1 prepare in bench_fn + (2 warmup + 10 measured) dispatches -- NO N^2, NO re-prepare-per-sample. Memory 86 MB (<< 50 GB cap).
checks.qa_signal_name_imprecision: CONFIRMED HARMLESS -- coder reported defect-1 crash as SIGFPE; QA and I both observed SIGSEGV / 'corrupted size vs. prev_size' heap-corruption abort instead, nondeterministic run-to-run. Consistent with real memory corruption from OOB, not a single deterministic trap. The qualitative crash claim is fully corroborated; the specific signal name is approximate. No impact on the milestone.

ub_check: FOUND_UB -- DEFECT-2: out-of-bounds buffer writes from workgroup-hole over-dispatch in run_optimize's new real-dispatch path (crash on non-robustBufferAccess devices, silent OOB on NVIDIA). Small per-variant-geometry fix required.

vendor_divergence_check: FAIL -- DEFECT-2 manifests DIFFERENTLY per vendor (Lavapipe/AMD-without-robustBufferAccess: crash; NVIDIA: silent clamped OOB / wrong winner), and DEFECT-1 is Lavapipe-Mesa-version-dependent. Both must be addressed/disclosed; DEFECT-2 fix is required.
summary: M3.23 wires a genuinely real GpuTimestamp MIN-of-N bench + detector-only variant differential into run_optimize, and the polish bundle (PW-1, i64 boundary, CRLF, note-cap) is clean and correct. I independently verified on the SHIPPED binary: the decision table's zero-artifact discipline holds on all three error paths; the 5 parser sites are fully migrated with the negated i64::MIN boundary correct and the body path untouched; PW-1 has no false-negative; perf is linear (4 candidates / 42ms, no N^2, no re-prepare-per-sample); oracle attribution is survivors-only. THE RULING (defect 2): the workgroup-dim-hole OOB crash is a BLOCKER, not ship-with-backlog. I reproduced it 3/3 on the canonical `@strategy { workgroup_x: ?[...] }` autotuning pattern -- the single most natural use of `axc optimize` -- via the shipped binary on Lavapipe (SIGSEGV/heap-corruption, zero artifacts), while a literal-workgroup control runs clean on the same Lavapipe. The triggering code is new to this milestone, and the correct fix -- derive geometry per-variant from the resolved LocalSize already present in the compiled `words` (I confirmed LocalSize=32 is emitted) -- is ~20-25 LOC in optimize.rs alone, needs no library/cross-crate change, and keeps AT-3014/AT-3016 passing. Since the fix is small AND strictly better than a refusal guard (it makes workgroup-size autotuning actually work), NEEDS_REVISION requiring the fix is the correct disposition. Two supporting findings: DEFECT-1 (shared-mem resident-harness crash on older Lavapipe) is a pre-existing runtime gap but M3.23 first exposes it in CI-gated ATs -> flag CI-Mesa-version risk; and the VariantsDiverge ordinals use the cfn-call counter rather than variant.ordinal (cosmetic, error path only). Fix DEFECT-2 and this is an APPROVE.
